summary: A language switcher with three options named in their own language; picking one awaits an async onselect before the value changes.
use: A language selector in a public header or settings: persist the choice, set the cookie and navigate to the localized URL, with the control busy meanwhile.
spec: `async function onselect(next: string)` waits 600 ms, then writes a visible `saved` note: Saved <locale>; the app would now go to /<locale>/login.
Before any pick the note reads `Pick a language: the switcher stays busy until onselect resolves.`
The column is left-aligned with `gap: var(--ca-space-3)`
